## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: mixed internals with broad sector participation but pronounced mega-cap divergences (AAPL BELOW TREND vs GOOGL ABOVE TREND and AMZN ABOVE TREND), and Leadership: Moderate (Top 5 span 3 sectors), so no clear directional bias.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Materials lead: NEM (1W: +9.11% | 1M: +19.66%) ABOVE TREND and FCX (1W: +7.90% | 1M: +26.39%) ABOVE TREND — Materials: 6/7 positive. Consumer Discretionary strong: LOW (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +10.03%) ABOVE TREND and HD (1W: +8.97% | 1M: +6.78%) ABOVE TREND — Consumer Disc.: 8/11 positive. Industrials robust: LMT (1W: +7.75% | 1M: +17.80%) ABOVE TREND and BA (1W: +5.12% | 1M: +20.68%) ABOVE TREND — Industrials: 10/13 positive.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Financials lag: CME (1W: -3.66% | 1M: -0.05%) BELOW TREND and AIG (1W: -12.19% | 1M: -8.14%) BELOW TREND — Financials: 7/20 positive. Communication and Energy show weakness: VZ not in detailed view but Communication overall negative and COP (1W: -3.73% | 1M: -1.34%) BELOW TREND for Energy — Communication: 3/7 positive; Energy: 3/8 positive.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: INTC (1W: +11.91% | 1M: +8.04%) ABOVE TREND, LOW (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +10.03%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +9.11% | 1M: +19.66%) ABOVE TREND, HD (1W: +8.97% | 1M: +6.78%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +8.06% | 1M: +11.66%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Moderate (3 sectors represented).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: CME (1W: -3.66% | 1M: -0.05%) BELOW TREND, COP (1W: -3.73% | 1M: -1.34%) BELOW TREND, CCI (1W: -3.88% | 1M: -5.12%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -3.99% | 1M: -7.10%) BELOW TREND, MET (1W: -4.22% | 1M: -1.88%) BELOW TREND — Weakness concentrated in pockets of Financials, Real Estate and select Tech names.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Strongest 1W: INTC (1W: +11.91% | 1M: +8.04%) ABOVE TREND, LOW (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +10.03%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +9.11% | 1M: +19.66%) ABOVE TREND — Note MAJOR DIVERGENCE across large caps (MSFT RECOVERY, NVDA CORRECTION, AAPL BELOW TREND, JPM CORRECTION): tactical caution, watch for trend break rather than broad regime shift.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed / selective. INTC (1W: +11.91% | 1M: +8.04%) ABOVE TREND and AMAT (1W: +8.06% | 1M: +11.66%) ABOVE TREND are leading while AAPL (1W: -2.62% | 1M: -6.65%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -6.06% | 1M: -6.20%) BELOW TREND and QCOM (1W: -3.99% | 1M: -7.10%) BELOW TREND lag — Sector breadth: 11/19 positive.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Rotation/strain within Financials. JPM (1W: -2.42% | 1M: +5.11%) CORRECTION, V (1W: -3.00% | 1M: +5.36%) CORRECTION and several credit names under pressure on fee headlines; a mix of 1W weakness vs 1M strength suggests caution — Sector breadth: 7/20 positive.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Generally constructive but idiosyncratic. LLY (1W: +3.79% | 1M: +8.79%) ABOVE TREND and JNJ (1W: +2.65% | 1M: +1.54%) ABOVE TREND show strength while UNH (1W: -0.44% | 1M: +3.70%) CORRECTION faces political headlines — Sector breadth: 9/15 positive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor Materials and select Consumer Discretionary/Industrials exposure (NEM ABOVE TREND, LOW ABOVE TREND, BA ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to idiosyncratic Financials and soft Tech names (AAPL BELOW TREND, AMD BELOW TREND). Monitor NVDA (1W: -1.69% | 1M: +0.63%) CORRECTION and MSFT (1W: +0.92% | 1M: -0.29%) RECOVERY for confirmation before reallocating core growth weight.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +11.91% | 1M: +8.04%) ABOVE TREND on analyst upgrades, NEM (1W: +9.11% | 1M: +19.66%) ABOVE TREND on commodity strength, LLY (1W: +3.79% | 1M: +8.79%) ABOVE TREND on AI partnership news. BEARISH: AIG (1W: -12.19% | 1M: -8.14%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -6.06% | 1M: -6.20%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -2.42% | 1M: +5.11%) CORRECTION on fee-cap headlines.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Materials (sector breadth strong; NEM, FCX ABOVE TREND) and Consumer Discretionary (LOW, HD ABOVE TREND) for momentum. BEARISH: Financials (credit-card fee talk pressuring names) and Communication (headline-driven weakness) — monitor breadth shifts.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
Watch NVDA (1W: -1.69% | 1M: +0.63%) CORRECTION for a decisive 1W>1M crossover as confirmation of resumed trend; INTC (1W: +11.91% | 1M: +8.04%) ABOVE TREND needs follow-through volume to validate momentum; AAPL (1W: -2.62% | 1M: -6.65%) BELOW TREND must reclaim its 1M to signal stabilization; JPM (1W: -2.42% | 1M: +5.11%) CORRECTION vulnerable to further policy/headline flows.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
INTC (+50): KeyBanc upgrade on hyperscaler demand; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.91% | 1M: +8.04%) — sentiment confirmed. LLY (+55): $1B AI tie-up with Nvidia; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.79% | 1M: +8.79%) — sentiment confirmed. BA (+55): 737 MAX sales; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.12% | 1M: +20.68%) — sentiment confirmed. AMD (+50): KeyBanc upgrade; price AMD BELOW TREND (1W: -6.06% | 1M: -6.20%) — bullish headlines diverging from price.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
UNH (-50): Senate scrutiny on Medicare payments; price CORRECTION (1W: -0.44% | 1M: +3.70%) — sentiment aligns with short-term weakness. TSLA (-50): margin/strategy concerns; price BELOW TREND (1W: -0.60% | 1M: -0.55%) — sentiment confirmed. JPM (-45): fee-cap headlines hit cards; price CORRECTION (1W: -2.42% | 1M: +5.11%) — sentiment may pressure 1W. CCI (-45): price-target cuts; price BELOW TREND (1W: -3.88% | 1M: -5.12%) — sentiment confirmed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, Style: mixed / no clear leadership.  
Materials and Consumer Discretionary showing relative strength: NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.11% | 1M: +19.66%), LOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +10.03%); Tech is mixed with INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.91% | 1M: +8.04%) while AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -2.62% | 1M: -6.65%).  
Key risk is the mega-cap divergence and headline-driven Financials weakness (credit-card fee chatter); monitor NVDA (CORRECTION) and MSFT (RECOVERY) crossovers and news-confirmed momentum in INTC/LLY.
